title: SEC0: PinnedCertVerifier fingerprint comparison is not constant-time
description: File: crates/transit/src/peering/xcid_client.rs:290. Issue: verify_server_cert compares actual != self.expected_sha256 using standard String equality, which short-circuits on the first differing byte. This is a variable-time comparison on a security-critical value. Impact: Timing oracle on cert fingerprint; exploitable only with network-level measurement capability and the ability to present arbitrary forged certs, so practical risk is low. Standard practice requires constant-time comparison on the raw digest bytes before hex-formatting.
